text.aria-label: Title text 'Injected 30 day load-shifts in the lag inputs only, March 2026: C1 + G4 (orange), A1 + G4 (blue) The target stays clean, so observed power (black) is also the NRA. Median and q05-q95 band, day-ahead. Grey shade: the injected shift. Sky-blue bar: G4 wide band on (or held for 7 days).'
text.tspan: Injected 30 day load-shifts in the lag inputs only, March 2026: C1 + G4 (orange), A1 + G4 (blue)
The target stays clean, so observed power (black) is also the NRA. Median and q05-q95 band, day-ahead.
Grey shade: the injected shift. Sky-blue bar: G4 wide band on (or held for 7 days).
